title: Evorove ICP
lead_summary: US B2B businesses with high-value deals that want to replace or avoid a sales team. For client 0 these are Evorove's own buyers.
client_note: A playbook names the leads a client wants found. It does not name the client's own industry. Client 0's leads are the companies that could buy Evorove. The subsegments below are searched together, not queued.

subsegments.title: Agencies
queries: marketing agency for B2B book a call
design agency for B2B book a call

subsegments.title: IT services and cybersecurity
queries: managed IT services provider for mid-size businesses
cybersecurity firm for B2B book a call

subsegments.why: needs_research: company-shaped queries still did not put a consulting or training firm into the pages this budget could read. Kept out of collection until a query shows those firms.
subsegments.title: Consulting and corporate training
queries: management consulting firm for B2B book a call
corporate training company for B2B book a call

subsegments.title: Recruiting
queries: B2B staffing firm book a call
executive search firm for B2B request a quote

subsegments.why: needs_research: distributor and equipment queries still return software about suppliers, not the suppliers. Kept out of collection.
subsegments.title: High-ticket B2B services and supply
queries: equipment distributor for B2B request a quote

subsegments.why: needs_research: construction and manufacturing software queries returned results, and none of those companies reached a page read ahead of agencies and IT firms. Kept out of collection until a query ranks an actual software company.
subsegments.title: Vertical B2B software
queries: construction software for mid-size businesses book a call
manufacturing software for B2B request a demo

signals.pattern: \bhiring\b.{0,60}\b(?:sdr|salesperson|sales manager|sales director|sales leader|vp of sales|head of sales|account executive|business development)\b
signals.how: A dated quote says the company is hiring a salesperson, SDR, or sales leader. The Cold reason is that sentence. An event no older than 30 days is hot. The same words stored as context and no older than 90 days are warm.

signals.pattern: \b(?:now hiring|we are hiring|we're hiring)\b.{0,60}\b(?:sales|sdr|account executive|business development)\b|\b(?:open|new)\s+sales\s+(?:role|position)\b|\bjoin our sales team\b
signals.how: A dated quote says a sales role is open. Event within 30 days is hot. Context within 90 days is warm. The catalog has no enabled job board, so this is visible only when the quote itself says it.

signals.pattern: \b(?:not enough (?:clients|customers|leads)|need more (?:clients|customers|leads)|pipeline is (?:thin|empty|slow|dry)|sales team is (?:too )?expensive|can(?:not|'t) afford (?:a |to hire )?(?:sales|an sdr|a salesperson))\b
signals.how: A dated public sentence says there are not enough clients or customers, or that a sales team is too expensive. Event within 30 days is hot. Context within 90 days is warm.
A dated quote says a service, practice, offering, or line was launched or is new. Event within 30 days is warm. Context within 90 days is cold.

signals.pattern: \b(?:growing (?:the|our) team|team is growing|we are growing|we're growing|new office)\b|\badded \d+ (?:people|employees|hires)\b
signals.how: A dated quote says the team is growing, a new office opened, or people were added. Event within 30 days is warm. Context within 90 days is cold.
A dated quote says marketing leadership changed or the company rebranded. Event within 30 days is warm. Context within 90 days is cold.
A quote says a marketing role is open. A date on that sentence or its page is the event. Without a date this is context, and the collection time is not the event date.
A quote says an operations role is open. A date on that sentence or its page is the event. Without a date this is context.
A quote says a case study was published. The phrase case studies in a menu is not this signal. A date on the sentence or the page is the event.

signals.pattern: \b(?:updated our pricing|new pricing|price increase|prices? (?:have|has) changed|pricing update)\b
signals.how: A quote says published prices changed. A date on the sentence or the page is the event. Without a date this is context.
A quote is an announcement. A date on the sentence or the page is the event. Without a date this is context.

signals.pattern: \b(?:we are expanding|we're expanding|expanding our|expansion into|opened a new office)\b
signals.how: A quote says the company is expanding or opened an office. A date on the sentence or the page is the event. Without a date this is context.

deal_size.how: At least one public sign must show a deal at or above $5000 a year. No model is asked. A published from-price below the floor rejects the company even when another sign is present. Dollar amounts that are not written as from, starting at, or starts at are ignored, so an incidental price is not treated as the deal.

signs.pattern: \b(?:custom pricing|contact us for pricing|request a quote|pricing on request)\b

signs.how: The rule sees the phrase. It does not check that the named clients are B2B.
team of 2 or more, or our team or leadership team together with at least two distinct roles. The words our team alone do not pass.

exclusions.how: Analysis already requires a fresh page that places the company in the US. A non-US fact never reaches the playbook rules.
A stored advertisement flag is rejected before the playbook rules.

Job boards, social networks, encyclopedias, dictionaries, question sites, list catalogs, marketplaces, and listed large corporations are dropped before a page is fetched. The host list is data/domain_blocklist.json.

The search title and snippet, or the page title, h1, meta description, and navigation, offer lead generation, outbound, cold email, sales automation, an SDR service, appointment setting, or a sales agency. That company sells the same motion Evorove sells. The patterns are data/competitor_offers.json. A case-study mention in the body is not this surface.
The company domain is a platform host, so it is not the company's own site.

exclusions.pattern: \b(?:law firm|law office|attorney at law|medical practice|our clinic|we are a bank|insurance agency|financial advisory firm)\b
exclusions.how: The page presents the company as a law, medical, banking, or insurance practice. A software page that only names those buyers can match the same words; that is a conservative miss, not a model judgment.

exclusions.pattern: \b(?:dental practice|dental office|hair salon|nail salon|auto repair shop|plumbing company|roofing company)\b
exclusions.how: The page presents the company as a local service for private individuals.

exclusions.pattern: \b(?:for homeowners|for families|for consumers|add to cart|shop now|direct to consumer)\b
exclusions.how: The page sells to households or runs a consumer shop.

exclusions.pattern: \b(?:saas for saas|for saas companies|developer platform|developer tool|built for developers)\b
exclusions.how: The offer is software sold to software companies or developers. That loop is outside the first wave.
A from, starting at, or starts at price annualizes below $5000. A monthly figure is multiplied by 12. One low published price rejects the page even if a higher price or book a call is also there.

gaps.why: needs_research: the catalog has no enabled job board. An open sales role is collected only when a dated public snippet states it.
needs_research: Reddit is disabled. A complaint about too few clients or an expensive sales team needs another public place whose terms allow collection.
needs_research: industry_rss is disabled. A dated article about a new service or a marketing change is not collected.

touch_angles: The Cold reason is one or two verbatim sentences from the company's own page about what it sells and to whom. A dated sales, hiring, or growth event sets the temperature. It is not required for the person to be cold.

A deal-size sign (book a call, custom pricing, a from-price at or above $5000 a year, a case-study phrase, or a team of more than one) can be stated only by copying the page. It is a fit check. It is not a claim that the company asked for Evorove.
The US sentence that placed the company can be copied. A country that was not on the page cannot.
Do not invent a price, a discount, a guarantee, or a legal claim. This repository does not write the letter.
